authority: Prospective, not data or a release. Only one arm, fraction and update nominated by the locked even-DEV encoder selection; all its nominated paired seeds. A failed gate never triggers another arm, feature, orientation, seed subset, temperature, or exam. No other study role, no native archive, no E or I, no prediction or hidden-label reader. CPU only.
measure: All FIT parents and all odd DEV roster-position parents at each admitted release index 0,1,2,3,4,5,7,8,9. Index 6 barred, explicitly absent not zero. In BOTH roles use stream draw ordinals 0,8,16,24,32,40,48,56. Each beta has mass 1/B, each parent equal within beta and each of its eight anchors equal. No subsampling of parents. FIT is the sole source for alignment, signs, regression slopes, normalization, baseline cuts and projection fitting. Never switch to per-beta f. Odd DEV is used for rule selection, stability/fidelity and contextual forecast development, not independent confirmation.
gauge: Lowest numeric seed reference. Argmax first raw column on ties. Rank reference classes by decreasing exact equal-beta hard mass, then mean softmax mass, then raw column. Reference log-odds is aligned first minus second logit. For each other seed maximize macro hard agreement, then mean soft probability dot product, then lexicographic raw permutation, over 24 permutations, using paired FIT anchors only. No alignment of sites or refitting on DEV. Within each seed standardize contrast globally by its FIT population moments; equal-seed mean continuous teacher. Zero SD contributes zero and fails stability. Category gauge permutations preserve ties only up to documented raw argmax rule. Report soft and hard marginal entropies, average draw entropy, information, tie fraction and pairs including whole-parent shift placebo at each beta and pooled.
dictionary: Exact historical hero-central/rule-prereg.json and hero_rule.FEATURES, 27 open sites in lexicographic (z,y,x), 0/vac,1/A,2/B. Costs, names, coordinates, directed edges and proper rotation convention unchanged. Fit all single-feature affine regressions of continuous teacher by equal-beta FIT moments. Rule fidelity R2=1-equal_beta_MSE/Var_equal_beta_odd_DEV(teacher); beta-specific descriptive R2 uses that beta's variance. Choose lowest cost within 0.02 of maximum odd-DEV R2, then higher R2, then ASCII key. No additional contrast or multifeature fit. Report all candidate scores and selected-minus-best-other R2 margin (may be negative by parsimony). Name the one selected descriptor even on failure, not a reproducible teacher estimate unless justified. No defined selection with absent required beta or constant teacher.
uncertainty: Pointwise per-beta and finite-panel mixture metrics use leave-one-whole-parent jackknife: change only that beta's empirical mean after deletion, keeping beta masses fixed. Sum beta variance contributions (n-1)/n times sum of squared centered leave-one differences and use Satterthwaite t df. For fidelity, margin and paired diagnostic metrics report pointwise 95% two-sided intervals conditional on frozen choices; selection sharing makes these descriptive, not confirmatory. Gate uses simultaneous one-sided 95% lower over both metrics for all seed pairs; these fixed seeds are not independent replicates. No per-site precision. n<2: SE/bound unavailable; n<8: visibly flagged. Empty required beta: no pooled rule qualification, never silently renormalize. An unmeasurable threshold fails.
symbolic_gate: Single conjunctive decision: >=3 paired seeds; per seed on equal-beta FIT and odd-DEV raw contrast SD >=0.25 natural units and each hard class mass >=0.02; every odd-DEV macro pair r>=0.60, kappa>=0.30 and simultaneous lower bounds r>0.40, kappa>0.10; selected odd-DEV macro R2>=0.50 and nonzero FIT slope and FIT raw feature variance >=1e-8. Same f=sign(FIT slope)*(x-global FIT mean)/global FIT population SD. Zero slope/variance or missing teacher is not a new search opportunity. f is not a 2-bit symbol. Report sign, formula, units, symmetry, macro Var_fit(f), local counts/moments; beta is never an argument to f or residual.
conventional: Same central controls as hero-central/rule-prereg: per-site indicators, densities, coordination/energy, signed and all oriented species pairs, origin-species x NN degree, proper crystal proxies and central S strata. Two-fold FIT-only within-beta parent roster parity cross-fitting of intercept, mean by S, centered OLS with covariance eigenvalue cut 1e-10 relative, OLS plus S residual; train with equal beta weight, choose smallest out-of-fold MSE using exact per-beta parent exposure across both folds. Ties within 1e-12 in listed order. Refit on all equal-beta FIT. If f is itself a conventional dictionary member the projection is exact identity, never an approximate ridge residual. Otherwise freeze a single projection function of V only. Report FIT and odd-DEV residual variance/Var_fit(f), MSE, within-S, and identity where applicable. Qualify for downstream physical gate only with symbolic gate passed, nonconventional feature and global FIT residual variance fraction >=0.10. This gives no exam authority.
secondary_geometry: NON-PROMOTING ambiguity diagnostic; no rotated teacher or alternative f. Use fixed reference seed and fixed reference category ordering; first min(256,n_FIT) parents per beta, all eight fixed draws. For each nonreference seed, factor an O_h map V'(r)=V(r M) (24 proper plus 24 improper signed coordinate permutations, exact lattice bijections) and a permutation of four raw classes. Score by equal-beta hard agreement, then soft dot; ties prefer identity then proper before improper, lexicographic matrix and raw class tuple. Report maximum-hard multiplicity, hard-and-soft ties (soft tolerance 1e-12 descriptive) and residual disagreement incl fraction of initial disagreement removed; fixed-frame comparator gets the same FIT opportunities and category search but identity M only. Freeze independently for genuine paired centers AND a same-beta exact-S cross-parent null before odd DEV. Partition each cohort within beta into consecutive disjoint blocks of at most 16 parents, choose uniformly another parent within block supporting this anchor's S then one of its eligible anchors by PCG64 fixed independent FIT/DEV seeds 26112531/26112532 + beta. Never match an anchor to itself or another anchor of same parent. Report unmatched support, genuine analysis also on exactly matched recipients and on ALL odd DEV opportunities. Same search space, tie rules, matched positions and frozen transform on null. For matched comparisons average within supported anchors then supported parents per beta; mismatches may reuse donors within block, so inference deletes whole independent parent blocks retaining per-beta supported-parent weighting, not single anchor or seed. No null results when a required beta has no support. Pairwise versus fixed reference report odd-DEV Pearson/kappa/agreement before/after, their paired changes, remaining disagreement, pointwise 95% delete-parent intervals on full genuine pairs and block intervals for matched panel. Separately report spread across fixed paired seeds. This is a descriptive test of geometric ambiguity, never a second selector or proof of a physical symmetry.
controls: Six hard codes: origin site, vacancy count, coordination, max literal A/B crystal template, fixed random affine/tanh (pilot seed 71991). Except site, cut at inverse empirical equal-beta FIT CDF (equality lower), quartiles for nonrandom and cumulative descending equal-beta FIT reference hard mass for random rate comparisons. Publish achieved hard mass/entropy at each beta and macro, not forced rate equality. Nuclear labels, physical data, GPU and pilot outcomes are not used for arithmetic controls. Check exact counts/weighting, planted categorical code with additive/permutation gauges, permutation ties, full extraction and exact/nonconventional residual, parent-interval and independent stratified whole-parent bootstrap sanity. Worker measures CPU/wall time and resource use; no paid services.
